verdicts.reason: Both candidates break the shoe off its lime circle. That circle was the key image in the original, and here it is a small cropped blob at the far right edge. In both, the NEW VIDEO badge has become a pill too small to read. A is worse: about the left 170px is empty dead space, the logo is pushed to the far right and jammed against the circle, and the shoe floats beside it, so the reading order is wrong. B puts the logo first on the left and the headline is clearly the main element. But the shoe sits low and crowds the bottom edge, and the gap between the copy block and the detached circle on the right looks arbitrary.
